a.lede: Tesla Cybertruck production will wind down in the middle of 2027 to make room for the Cybercab robotaxi.
a.title: Tesla is 'winding down' Cybertruck production at its Texas Gigafactory

b.lede: Elon Musk said the company will use the factory space to make more Cybercabs.
b.title: Tesla will stop making the Cybertruck in 2027
